knowledge.badge: A New Era in Medical Knowledge
knowledge.lead: For decades, clinical knowledge has been fragmented across PDFs, journals, society websites, and institutional silos.
problemItems: Guidelines buried in 200-page PDFs across dozens of society websites
Updates take years; clinicians work with outdated recommendations
No way to compare ACR vs EULAR vs APLAR approaches side-by-side
Clinical pearls lost in individual practice, never shared globally

solutionItems.text: All societies, all guidelines, all protocols — searchable instantly
Real-time updates as new evidence emerges
Instant answers, comparisons, and clinical decision support

knowledge.quote: "Imagine asking any clinical question and getting the synthesized wisdom of ACR, EULAR, APLAR, and 50+ rheumatology societies — in seconds, with citations."

roadmap.lead: Community suggestions guiding development. Each block is independent — contribute where your expertise is strongest.
roadmap.mvpDesc: To build momentum, starting with a small but functional core demonstrates value and attracts contributors from day one.
mvpItems: Core entities: encounters, observations and medications
Simple interface to visualize continuity over time
roadmap.fhirDescMid: resources — no need for full conformance upfront.
fhirItems: Easier onboarding for contributors with healthcare experience
Greater credibility for pilots and integrations
roadmap.consentDesc: Since health data is sensitive, consent and audit must be core features — not later additions.
consentItems: Granular and revocable consent per data type and provider
Immutable audit logs for every access and change
roadmap.archDesc: A layered approach enables scalability and lets contributors work independently on different domains.
roadmap.ctaDesc: These suggestions come from the community. Want to propose an implementation, challenge a decision, or suggest new directions? Open a Discussion on GitHub.

privacy.body: UHS Health OS is an organizational tool, not a medical record system. We never store patient names, government IDs, phone numbers, or addresses. Use your own patient codes for reference — we never see the real identifiers.

finalCta.lead: Whether you're a clinician seeking better workflows, a researcher needing auditable data, or a patient wanting control — UHS Health OS is built for you.

footer.disclaimer: This is an organizational tool for healthcare professionals. It does not constitute an official medical record system. No PHI/PII is stored on the blockchain.
